description: This file contains PHP classes for cryptographic functions used in session management, specifically MD5Crypt and SHA1Crypt classes with methods for encryption, decryption, and random password generation.

classes.name: MD5Crypt
classes.description: Provides methods for MD5-based encryption, decryption, and password generation.

classes.name: SHA1Crypt
classes.description: Provides methods for SHA1-based encryption, decryption, and password generation.

methods.name: keyED
methods.description: Encrypts or decrypts text using a key, with MD5 or SHA1 hashing depending on class.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts text with a random key and encodes it in base64.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts text encrypted by the Encrypt method.
